title: MemoryEpisode
description: A distilled unit of agent memory extracted from the transcript store (binder ch04 memory tiers: recall/archival/graph; ch07 M6 'episodic memory extraction' + 'graph facts with validity intervals'). VALIDITY RULE (ADR-0097, normative): every episode carries a bi-temporal validity interval — validFrom/validUntil for when the fact held in the world, ingestedAt for when the system learned it (the Zep/Graphiti bi-temporal model per the episodic-memory-algorithms skill). validUntil is required-but-nullable so open-endedness is an explicit assertion, never an omission. CITATION RULE: 'a memory without a source is a suggestion, not a fact' (ch04 retrieval policy) — citations has minItems 1. DELETION RULE: sourcePayloadState implements the ch04 distilled-source contract — derived memory must not pretend a deleted raw source still exists; a consumer renders 'source payload deleted' when only a tombstone remains. Field names follow ADR-0095 fork resolution 1 (agentNodeId/sessionId/runId); superseded ch03/ch04-sketch names (agentId) must not reappear. Citation cross-field enforcement (kind=transcript-event requires transcriptEventId, etc.) is runtime, per the compaction-packet pattern.

tier.description: ch04 memory tier this episode belongs to. Blackboard is a separate read-model contract (blackboard-item.schema.json), not a tier here.

agentNodeId.description: The agent the episode is about, when agent-scoped. Null for repo/project-scoped memory.

sessionId.description: The session the episode was extracted from, when session-scoped.

scope.description: What the memory attaches to for retrieval routing (ch04: project, repo, agent, or workgroup).

summary.description: The distilled memory text: what happened / what is true.

facts.description: Structured graph facts (subject, predicate, object) when tier=graph — 'agent worked on file, PR fixed issue, skill helped task' (ch04). Each fact inherits the episode's validity interval unless it carries its own.

validFrom.description: When the remembered fact became true in the world (event time, not ingest time).

validUntil.description: When the fact stopped holding; null = still valid. Required-but-nullable: open-ended validity is asserted, not defaulted. A retrieval layer must not serve episodes whose validUntil has passed as current facts (ch04 graph memory; stale-memory-pollution failure mode).

ingestedAt.description: When the system learned/extracted the fact — the second temporal axis of the bi-temporal model. Enables 'what did we believe on date D' queries and audit.

supersedes.description: Episode ids this episode invalidates (contradiction/superseding logic: closing their validUntil is the runtime effect).

supersededBy.description: The episode that invalidated this one, when validUntil was closed by contradiction.

extractedBy.description: Provenance of the extraction (ch04 skill-creation pipeline step 2: Longshoreman extracts with source citations).

citations.description: Source citations back to transcript events, files, or claims. minItems 1 is the schema-level half of ch04's 'facts need validity intervals and sources'.

sourcePayloadState.description: ch04 distilled-source contract: the state of the cited raw payload. When deleted/expired, sourceTombstone must carry the hash so the derivation stays verifiable-in-shape even though the payload is gone.

sourceTombstone.description: Present when sourcePayloadState is not 'present': the original event tombstone and hash, the derivation transform, and the degraded-confidence policy (ch04 deletion and derived memory).

derivationTransform.description: How the digest/excerpt was derived from the deleted source.

digest.description: Redacted excerpt or user-approved digest, when one was allowed to survive.

importance.description: Retrieval-priority score; drives the forgetting policy tier.

forgettingPolicy.description: How this episode decays (episodic-memory-algorithms skill: never_forget / half-life decay / session-scoped).

embeddingRef.description: Reference into the shared embedder index (versioned by model id, so re-embedding on model change is detectable).
